# Google Play screenshots, 17 Nov 2026

Save every picture below into C:\Users\jwbur\app game\play-uploads\screenshots-2026-11-17\<game>\.
In Play Console, for each game: Grow users -> Store presence -> Store listings -> Main store listing -> Graphics.

- 7-inch tablet screenshots and 10-inch tablet screenshots: add the play-tablet pictures in number order (same pictures in both).
Leave text, icon and feature graphic alone. Stop before Save: Joseph presses Save and Send changes for review.
